decisions.reason: Existing in-scope scripts and technical memory paths may be validated without expanding permissions.
Technical lessons may be corrected or revoked within their existing authorized scope.
Publishing private role memory beyond its authorized scope changes permission; it is not authorized by the proposal.

remaining: Do not describe the pilot tools as a general natural-language planning or expert-routing runtime.
Run the existing adapter and work-pilot checks; inspect their bounded outputs and limitations.
Measure memory's effect and human time separately in a controlled, scoped verification.
Obtain explicit human authorization before sharing private role memory outside its authorized scope.
Expertise proposal remains under review; no implementation or publication is authorized by it.
